name: Shakti back-and-forth: both signals reversed, then corrected
origin: Todd Murphy (Shakti software), after Persinger's vectorial hemisphericity theory
summary: The two-signal form of Murphy's back-and-forth session: first the amygdala signal over the right temporal lobe and the hippocampal signal over the left (both on their 'usually wrong' sides), then the amygdala signal over the left frontal lobe and the hippocampal signal over the right frontal lobe. Murphy says phase 1 is expected to be unpleasant and calls the procedure 'Less-well tested for women, untested for men'.
setting: Advanced users only, after a side test has shown the usual pattern for the signal (this file assumes the usual sides). The vendor says darkness and silence (sensory deprivation) help; eyes closed, relaxed. Test both signals first (murphy-shakti-test-session-amygdala and -hippocampus, at least 72 hours apart).
schedule: Vendor rules: never on consecutive days, at most every 72 hours or weekly; 60-minute sessions at most once in 3 weeks.
notes: 'Alternative procedures' gives 30 + 30 min and names no lobes. 'Bliss' ('2) More complicated') gives two phases of 20 to 30 min on a stereo headset and puts phase 2 over the frontal lobes, the amygdaloid signal left and the hippocampal signal right. Played here: the Bliss lobes, 30 min each, one coil pair per signal (C6 and T8 with C5 and T7, then F3 and AF3 with F4 and AF4), each pair one (+) and one (-) coil as in the vendor's four-coil photos. The site names and playing both signals at once are the project's reading. The amygdala burst is the project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz, 0.69 s). The hippocampal signal is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). Both are rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's files are not published. The burst repeats every 4.69 s, the train every 4.74 s, so they drift against each other. Field strength: the vendor's 10 to 50 mG are gaussmeter readings at a coil (FAQ). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 56 uT at the coil face, 11 to 56 times the vendor's level. 'Bliss' calls the procedure 'Less-well tested for women, untested for men'. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Phase 1 is 'EXPECTED to be unpleasant'. If it gets too uncomfortable, press Skip to start phase 2, and never stop after phase 1. With headache or pressure, lower the intensity by one third. For lingering effects the vendor names ERP over the cerebellum (murphy-shakti-cerebellum-erp). Run murphy-shakti-back-and-forth-amygdala and murphy-shakti-back-and-forth-hippocampus first. Not for people with epilepsy, seizure history or a psychiatric condition; stop if distress continues in phase 2.
